r11_city_lanes.standard: Good enough to ship next to the approved art. Exact path layout and mask are mandatory; a clean mask alone does not excuse conspicuous texture repetition.
r11_city_lanes.previous_review: critic-r11L-1.json read. Modern and scifi SHA-256 values are unchanged: both previous passes are preserved. Jazz_age and wasteland changed and were re-reviewed.
checks_performed: Read BRIEF-11.md including owner continuity feedback. Reviewed only its four candidate lane files; approved art and named references were used for comparison.

Compared every lane against its family path_joined and road_joined reference. All four are 192x1104 with 4 columns by 23 rows of 48-pixel cells. Whole-sheet opaque-mask, nonzero-mask and exact alpha equality each have zero mismatches. No partial alpha pixels. This also verifies placement, lane width and join geometry pixel for pixel.
Viewed all four complete candidate atlases at native 1x, and every source pixel in six nearest-neighbour 8x bands per candidate. Saved 1x, 4x and 8x source bands.

Assembled and viewed cross, T, bend and diagonal runs on both grass-base and wasteland-wasteland-base at 1x and nearest-neighbour 4x, beside matching main-road strips and a direct lane-to-road junction.
Viewed eight-piece repeated horizontal lane strips beside their family roads on both grounds at 1x and 4x. Saved extended horizontal, vertical and diagonal runs as additional evidence.

Assembled and viewed seeded random 8x2 lane networks on both grounds at 1x and 4x. Seed 111; shared N/E/S/W edges agree. Layout saved in critic-r11L-2-random-layout.json. Arbitrary incompatible atlas cells were not treated as seamless neighbours.
Compared with approved jazz_age/modern/scifi/wasteland markers, round-2 city/slums/industry, paddies, grass/plains bases and details in the saved approved-style-comparison board.

Checked seams, brightness steps, per-piece borders, surface continuity, repeated texture rhythm, material and palette matching, kerbs, cyan glints, crack readability, sand, pixel sharpness, alpha fringe/halo and scale. All four use only colours from their corresponding family road reference.
Verified all out/ PNG hashes against the inventory captured for this review: no changes.
r11_city_lanes.not_applicable: This brief contains summer-only lane atlases, used all year. It contains no candidate bases, peaks, trees, ruins, craters or seasonal crowns. Candidate-base 3x3 tiling, peak lattice/range composites, forest composites, winter coverage, egg-crate peaks, Swiss-cheese craters, classical ruins and flat orange autumn/identical crowns are therefore outside this review scope. The scifi lane was checked for a stamped panel grid; it does not copy the road grid onto its lane surface.

passing_files.jazz_age-lane: PASS after revision. The former bright transverse boundary stitch is removed. The dominant fill is now RGB(141,121,88), matching the supplied main road, with pale outer kerb and darker inner edge. Cross/T/bend/diagonal and random networks read continuously at 1x on both grounds. Small repeated grain and inherited silhouette variations are visible enlarged, but do not form conspicuous transverse slabs or a seam rhythm at native size. Clean exact mask and no halo. The supplied road is warm tan: its actual appearance is the material/palette baseline.
passing_files.modern-lane: PASS preserved: byte-identical to the previous passing file. Grey asphalt, light kerb and dark inner edge remain compatible with the road. Required layouts survive 1x/4x and the full 8x sheet inspection. No concrete new defect found.
passing_files.scifi-lane: PASS preserved: byte-identical to the previous passing file. Dark blue-grey surface matches the road without repeating its panel grid across lane joins. Only 36 cyan-coloured pixels in the atlas; glints occur on selected pieces. Required layouts survive 1x/4x and the full 8x sheet inspection. No concrete new defect found.

wasteland-lane.resolved_since_previous_review: Connected cracks and visible sand intrusions now exist; the previous disconnected-chip-only complaint is resolved. Palette, mask and road value also pass.
wasteland-lane.remaining_defect: The horizontal repeat has a dominant scalloped dark fissure and one large rounded light sand patch per 48-pixel tile. The same eight motifs are visible in the eight-piece run at 1x on both grounds; 4x/8x show the repeated stamp clearly. Vertical runs also reuse an equally recognisable forked centre crack.
wasteland-lane.source_location: Zero-based straight tile 10: sheet x=96..143, y=96..143. Its RGB(116,109,97) sand patch contains 79 pixels and spans local x=27..43, y=16..24. This same rounded intrusion recurs at x+48k when tiled. A strong RGB(63,59,55) scalloped fissure crosses the surface below it.

fail.name: wasteland-lane
fail.problems: FAIL visible texture repetition/continuity. In the eight-piece straight run, the same large rounded sand tongue and scalloped dark crack repeat every 48 px, visibly at 1x on both grass and wasteland. This reads as a stamped garland of damage rather than irregular cracked asphalt. Tile 10 (sheet x=96..143, y=96..143) has a 79-pixel light sand stamp at local x=27..43, y=16..24; its prominence makes each repeat easy to count. Vertical runs repeat the same forked centre fissure too. Reduce the rounded patch to smaller, irregular, lower-contrast edge drifts; break up the dominant repeating wave/fork with restrained asymmetric cracks and short branches that remain continuous through joins. Re-test eight straight pieces at 1x until no single damage stamp advertises each cell. Keep the existing road palette and exact path alpha mask; no widening or relocation. Evidence: critic-r11L-2-wasteland-straight-join-evidence-{1,4,8}x.png and both all-*-lane-road-repeat-strips-1x.png composites.
